Since the graph of $f(x)$ passes through $(1,-4)$, we have that $f(1)=-4.$ Therefore, the tangent line approximation of $f(x)$ at $a=1$ is 

$$
\begin{aligned}L(x) & =f(a)+{f}^{′}(a)(x-a) \\  & =f(1)+{f}^{′}(1)(x-1) \\  & =-4+2(x-1) \\  & =-4+2x-2 \\  & =2x-6.\end{aligned}
$$
